source_snapshot.criteria: Both list forms and Web match SPEC; numbering is 1, 2, 71.
source_snapshot.script: No Script; Config-Check; 3/0 minutes; same code as row 1194 SEL Allocation variant.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES/ipmitool but invents one title sensor, truncates OOB evidence and erases the multi-record status population.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/HIGH; requires inclusion list, per-record component/state decoding, fault preservation and shared-code isolation.

old_problem: STATUS is only a broad substring that can match unrelated component records with different discrete bit meanings. The source lacks an inclusion list, record IDs/types, component map and accepted raw/decoded states, orders evidence-destroying log clearing, and shares its code with row 1194 Get SEL Allocation Info. Criteria jump from 2 to 71.
disposition_reason: Resolve Pending and Source Conflict through ED-02 Source Key/Variant isolation and ED-03 parameterization of the exact STATUS inclusion/state map. Complete inventories preserve discovery, but only signed members are graded. ED-17 prohibits clearing status/SEL evidence and ED-15 forbids invented state oracles. Row 1194 remains a separate SEL capacity case and can never satisfy this coverage.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2032, same-row DeepSeek, GPT V2, historical record, manifest duplicate-code identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; next row was directly opened as Functionality 2033 / Wistron-BMC-01052-V002 / ec498048700e53f3.
This review is bound to Functionality|2032 and ce41ec26bca184f9; same-code row 1194 concerns SEL Allocation Info, not component health.
Full IB/OOB lists are retained before filtering. Each approved STATUS record is identified by record ID/type and bound to a component/function with raw-bit and decoded-state rules.
Critical, failed or unknown state causes a stop and evidence preservation; no configuration or automatic retry is introduced.
Criteria 1, 2 and 71 remain, while absent 3-70 are not fabricated.
No ipmitool, status query, authentication, Web capture, state/threshold write, log clear or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: Variant-isolated component STATUS population and raw-state reconciliation
test_case.purpose: Verify every owner-approved row-2032 STATUS record is mapped to the correct component/health function and has consistent record type, raw state, decoded state, description and freshness across IB/OOB SDR, IB/OOB Sensor List and BMC Web.
required_package: Exact row-2032 Source Key/Variant and SUT/BMC/firmware/channel identity; row-1194 SEL exclusion
Versioned STATUS inclusion list with record IDs/types and component/health-function ownership
Per-record raw-bit decoder, accepted/degraded/critical/unknown states, aliases and freshness/view crosswalk
Preserved component fault and SEL context, approved ipmitool and protected access
BMC/platform owner and human Web/verdict responsibility
test_case.test_command: STRICTLY READ-ONLY PACKAGE-GATED; verify row-2032 variant identity and preserve existing component/status/SEL evidence. Capture complete aligned IB/OOB `sdr elist` and `sensor list` before STATUS filtering, enumerate every signed included record by ID/type, and capture all corresponding Web rows. Compare raw/decoded state, description and freshness using the approved component map. Do not query an invented title sensor, merge row 1194, clear logs, write status/threshold/configuration or retry automatically.
test_case.expected_result: Every approved row-2032 STATUS member appears exactly once for the correct component with aligned fresh raw/decoded healthy state and description in all supported views; no unexpected critical, failed or unknown condition exists and row-1194 evidence is absent.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact variant isolation, complete signed population and full supported-view raw/decoded evidence matching the approved state map. FAIL on wrong-variant evidence, missing/extra/duplicate/stale record, component/decoder mismatch, channel disagreement or critical/failed/unknown state. Missing inclusion/decoder is NOT READY; user owns verdict.
safety_gate: Passive reads only; no status, threshold, component configuration or fault injection.
Preserve status/SEL evidence before reads and protect credentials.
Stop on critical, failed or unknown state, missing/duplicate record, identity mismatch or channel disagreement.
No automatic retry or log clearing; preserve first raw values and context.
expected_evidence: Exact row-2032 Source Key/Variant/hash and row-1194 isolation audit
SUT/BMC/firmware/channel plus versioned inclusion, record-type, component and decode map
Full timestamped IB/OOB SDR and Sensor-list raw outputs with exits/hashes
Complete Web evidence for every included record
Per-member raw/decoded/description/freshness and missing/extra/duplicate analysis with preserved SEL context
test_case.recovery: On wrong variant/target, access failure, unknown record type, critical/failed state or view mismatch, stop and preserve the first raw state plus SEL context. Close sessions and rotate exposed credentials. Do not clear, write, reset or retry; escalate exact record ID and component.

source_conflict.reason: Exact Source Key/Variant isolation, signed membership and record-aware decoding resolve broad STATUS ambiguity while log preservation removes the safety conflict; row 1194 remains separate.

blocked.reason: Passive population reconciliation, evidence, safety and recovery are defined; inclusion/state maps are Project Configuration.
